name: Lebesgue measure
description: Countably-additive set function generalizing length/area/volume; foundation for modern integration + probability. Substrate-relevant for probabilistic atom weight assignment + integration over high-dimensional concept space.

name: Lebesgue integration
description: Integration via measurable simple-function approximation; dominates Riemann for limit interchange (DCT/MCT/Fatou). Substrate-relevant for expectation operators + integral cleanup analysis.

name: Kolmogorov probability axioms
description: Probability as normalized measure on sigma-algebra: P(empty)=0 + P(Omega)=1 + countable additivity. Foundation for substrate-relevant Bayesian inference + uncertainty quantification.

name: Lp function spaces
description: Banach spaces of p-integrable functions; L2 is Hilbert. Substrate-relevant: L2 inner product underlies similarity score + spectral methods + Fourier analysis.

name: Hilbert space
description: Complete inner-product space; orthonormal basis enables projection + Parseval identity + spectral theorem. Substrate-relevant: HRR/FHRR atoms live in finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces.

name: Fourier transform on L2
description: Unitary isomorphism L2(R)->L2(R) extending Fourier integral; Plancherel preserves L2 norm. Substrate-relevant: FHRR binding is circular convolution = pointwise multiplication in Fourier domain.

name: Convolution theorem
description: Fourier transform converts convolution to pointwise multiplication: F(f*g)=F(f).F(g). Substrate-relevant: FHRR binding via FFT-multiply-IFFT is O(N log N) versus O(N^2) direct convolution.

name: Metric topology
description: Topology induced by distance function via open balls; standard for finite-dimensional analysis. Substrate-relevant: cosine distance defines metric on unit hypersphere where atoms live.

name: General topology
description: Open-set axioms + continuity + compactness + connectedness; foundation for analysis on abstract spaces. Substrate-relevant: continuity of similarity score under perturbation.

name: Differential geometry of manifolds
description: Smooth manifolds + tangent spaces + Riemannian metric + connections + curvature. Substrate-relevant: high-dimensional concept space as manifold; geodesic distance generalizes cosine.

name: Lie groups + Lie algebras
description: Smooth groups with tangent algebra; exponential map links algebra to group. Substrate-relevant: rotation group SO(N) acts on hypersphere atoms; permutation P^k generalizes via Lie group action.

name: Finite group theory
description: Groups of finite order + Sylow theorems + Lagrange + group action + orbits/stabilizers. Substrate-relevant: permutation group S_N acts on atom dimensions for P^k binding.

name: Finite-group representation theory
description: Group homomorphisms to GL(V); characters + irreducible decomposition + orthogonality. Substrate-relevant: HRR binding is group convolution on cyclic group; characters underlie Fourier basis.

name: Category theory basics
description: Categories + functors + natural transformations + universal properties + Yoneda. Substrate-relevant: functorial mapping between substrate partitions + universal binding constructions.

name: Monoidal + symmetric monoidal categories
description: Categories with tensor product + unit + coherence; foundation for compositional semantics. Substrate-relevant: substrate binding is symmetric monoidal product on atom category.

name: Enumerative combinatorics
description: Counting principles + generating functions + Polya enumeration + species. Substrate-relevant: counting substrate compositions + bundling capacity + role-filler arrangements.

name: Graph theory
description: Vertices + edges + paths + cycles + spectral properties + connectivity + matchings. Substrate-relevant: concept_links form graph; spectral embedding via Laplacian eigenvectors.

name: Spectral graph theory
description: Eigenvalues of adjacency/Laplacian matrices encode graph structure; Cheeger inequality + expander mixing. Substrate-relevant: substrate graph Laplacian spectral gap measures partition quality.

name: Markov chains
description: Discrete-time stochastic processes with memoryless transitions; stationary distribution + ergodicity + mixing time. Substrate-relevant: substrate retrieval as random walk on concept_links graph.

name: Markov chain Monte Carlo
description: Sample from target distribution via Markov chain with target as stationary; Metropolis-Hastings + Gibbs + HMC. Substrate-relevant: posterior sampling over atom weights + Bayesian retrieval.

name: Shannon information theory
description: Entropy + mutual information + KL divergence + channel capacity + source coding. Substrate-relevant: mutual information atom<->capability measures substrate informativeness.

name: Information bottleneck principle
description: Compress X to T preserving max I(T;Y); minimize I(X;T) - beta I(T;Y). Substrate-relevant: atom compression preserving task-relevant information + capability-discriminative weighting.

name: Convex optimization
description: Convex objective + convex constraint set; global optimum reachable; KKT conditions. Substrate-relevant: cleanup energy minimization + bundling optimization frequently convex.

name: Lagrangian duality
description: Primal-dual formulation + weak/strong duality + Slater condition + KKT. Substrate-relevant: dual formulation of substrate retrieval as inner-product maximization with norm constraints.

name: Stochastic approximation
description: Recursive estimation under noisy gradient; Robbins-Monro + Kiefer-Wolfowitz + ODE limit. Substrate-relevant: SGD convergence to substrate weights + online substrate updates.

name: Concentration of measure inequalities
description: Hoeffding + Chernoff + Bernstein + McDiarmid + sub-gaussian tail bounds. Substrate-relevant: high-dimensional atom concentration + bundling noise tail bounds.

name: Random matrix theory bulk + edge
description: Wigner semicircle + Marchenko-Pastur + Tracy-Widom edge + free probability. Substrate-relevant: substrate atom covariance spectrum + free cumulant kappa_4 + spectral gap diagnostics.

name: Orthogonal wavelet bases
description: Multiresolution analysis + scaling functions + Daubechies + Mallat fast wavelet transform. Substrate-relevant: multi-scale atom decomposition + hierarchical substrate retrieval.

name: Compressed sensing
description: Sparse recovery from underdetermined linear measurements via L1 minimization; RIP + Donoho-Tanner phase transition. Substrate-relevant: sparse substrate retrieval from few measurements + L1 cleanup.

name: Johnson-Lindenstrauss embedding
description: Random projection preserves pairwise distances up to (1+eps) with target dim O(log n / eps^2). Substrate-relevant: random hyperdimensional projection underlies FHRR/HRR atom encoding capacity.
